stem: Which one of the following is not correctly matched?
expl: The international border between India and Pakistan (India and Bangladesh) has been determined by the Radcliffe Line. stem: Rio Grande river makes boundary between –
expl: Rio Grande river separates the southern border of the United States of America from Mexico. It was identified in 1845. The basin of this river is spread across the United States of America and Mexico. Rhine river forms the border between France and Germany.

stem: Which one of the following lakes forms as an International boundary between Tanzania and Uganda?
expl: Lake Victoria is also known as Victoria Nyanza. It is the world’s second largest freshwater lake by surface area. Tanzania, Uganda and Kenya have administrative authority over this lake. Lake Victoria forms an international border between Uganda-Tanzania, Uganda-Kenya and Kenya-Tanzania.

stem: Radcliffe Line defines the boundary between
expl: Radcliffe Line defines the boundary between India and Pakistan, India and Bangladesh. The 38th (380N) parallel line defines the boundary between North Korea and South Korea and the 49th (490N) parallel line defines the boundary between the United States of America and Canada. Similarly, the Mac Mahon Line defines the boundary between India and China.

stem: 38th Parallel border lines divide which of the two following countries?
expl: The 38th (380N) parallel or Northern latitude line defines the boundary between North Korea and South Korea. The Oder Neisse Line separates Poland from Germany. Durand line separates Pakistan from Afghanistan and India from Afghanistan while the Radcliffe Line separates India-Pakistan and India-Bangladesh and McMahon Line separates India from China.

stem: The longest border between any two countries in the world is between:

options.label: a
options.text: Canada and the United States of America

expl: Canada's border with the United States of America is the world's longest international border, at 8,891 km. In comparison, the border between the Russian Federation and Kazakhstan measures 6,846 km. and the Chile-Argentina border measures 5,308 km. while India shares 3,488 km. of border with China. Hence, option (a) is the correct answer.

stem: Which longitude separates Canada and Alaska?
expl: Under the Convention of April 1906, commissioners were appointed to define the 141st meridian west as the boundary line between the United States and Canada. This boundary stretched from the Arctic Ocean to Mount Saint Elias, covering a distance of approximately 647 miles.
